g.text: T6: telem stale · T7: ack timeout
Solid arrow: operator command or time rule. Dashed arrow: observed telemetry. Filled dot: initial state.
Internal: T4 preflight rejection · T10 disarm rejection · T15–T18 replies · T19 telemetry update.
Each Cycle: events in arrival order, then CycleEnd (T6 before T7; T12), then Status if it changed.
Every operator command gets exactly one Reply. Accepted ≠ armed: completion is the observed state.
